title: Userbenchmark - the April Fools that never ends
summary: 2kliksphilip examines UserBenchmark, a hardware comparison site known for strongly biased, pro-Intel writing. The video explains the site's credibility problems and points viewers to better sources for CPU and GPU information.
why: HN uses it as the go-to link to warn people not to trust UserBenchmark for hardware comparisons.

quote.text: There's a great video about the site here for those who are curious
